subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Stakeholder vs Shareholder Theory
description: A short lesson to help you apply Stakeholder vs Shareholder Theory.

hook.text: Should a company exist only to maximize shareholder profit? Or does it owe something to employees and communities?

buildup.text: Shareholder theory says profit is the sole purpose. Stakeholder theory says companies must serve broader interests.

discovery.text: In 2019, 181 CEOs signed the Business Roundtable statement endorsing stakeholder capitalism.

twist.text: Critics say stakeholder theory gives executives cover to pursue any agenda without accountability to anyone.

climax.text: The debate shapes governance globally. Who the company serves determines how it's run.

punchline.text: Serve shareholders only? Or everyone? The debate rages on.

quiz.question: What does stakeholder theory argue?
options: Companies must serve employees, communities, and shareholders
Stakeholders should run the company directly
